svg.title: The Buy-Low, Sell-High Flip Loop
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-beginner-flip-loop; chapter number: 1; title: The Buy-Low, Sell-High Flip Loop; subtitle: Register cheap, screen hard, price on comps, list wide, renew with intent; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Register Cheap, Cap the Spend; value: Step 1; detail: Registrations cluster around $6 to $10 with $20 to $50 per-name caps; .com first, since about 75% of all domain sales are .com (Thinking Blueprint), with .ai and .io as the hot alternates.; step: 02; label: Reject Flawed Candidates; value: Step 2; detail: Any candidate with a dash, a creative misspelling, or a date is rejected before it reaches the cart (Make Money with Stacy La).; step: 03; label: Price on Appraisal Plus Comps; value: Step 3; detail: Pair the GoDaddy appraisal with NameBio comparable sales, and relist at a new price if 90 days pass without a sale (David Utke).; step: 04; label: List Wide on Afternic; value: Step 4; detail: Point a Namecheap-registered name's nameservers to Afternic to cut the commission from 25% to 15% and unlock fast transfer plus a for-sale lander (David Utke).; step: 05; label: Close in Escrow, Renew or Drop; value: Step 5; detail: Refuse pay-later buyers and close only through escrow (DomainRacer Hindi); auto-renew keepers and drop unsold dead weight before renewal (Andrey Verevko).; caption: KT Blogger turned a fresh $10 hand-registration into a $1,500 sale, while Andrey Verevko bought at $10, renewed at 15, sold at 20, and ended five bucks in the hole.; assumptions note: Step order follows the loop described across sixteen Q1 operators; all prices and commission rates are as stated by the named practitioners, not independently verified.; note: Sources Thinking Blueprint (12ohlClK0g8 @ 00:02:27), Make Money with Stacy La (SuiwtFN2AO8 @ 00:04:48), David Utke (A6-lVEeaHEs @ 00:05:02 and 00:10:27), DomainRacer Hindi (eDmh_k07UEg @ 00:03:18), Andrey Verevko (bVQnMN-Qrd8 @ 00:09:05).

circle.title: step: 01; label: Register Cheap, Cap the Spend; value: Step 1; detail: Registrations cluster around $6 to $10 with $20 to $50 per-name caps; .com first, since about 75% of all domain sales are .com (Thinking Blueprint), with .ai and .io as the hot alternates.

circle.title: step: 03; label: Price on Appraisal Plus Comps; value: Step 3; detail: Pair the GoDaddy appraisal with NameBio comparable sales, and relist at a new price if 90 days pass without a sale (David Utke).

text.title: Pair the GoDaddy appraisal with NameBio comparable sales, and relist at a new price if 90 days pass without a sale (David Utke).

circle.title: step: 04; label: List Wide on Afternic; value: Step 4; detail: Point a Namecheap-registered name's nameservers to Afternic to cut the commission from 25% to 15% and unlock fast transfer plus a for-sale lander (David Utke).

text.title: Point a Namecheap-registered name's nameservers to Afternic to cut the commission from 25% to 15% and unlock fast transfer plus a for-sale lander (David Utke).

circle.title: step: 05; label: Close in Escrow, Renew or Drop; value: Step 5; detail: Refuse pay-later buyers and close only through escrow (DomainRacer Hindi); auto-renew keepers and drop unsold dead weight before renewal (Andrey Verevko).

text.title: Refuse pay-later buyers and close only through escrow (DomainRacer Hindi); auto-renew keepers and drop unsold dead weight before renewal (Andrey Verevko).
Assumptions: Step order follows the loop described across sixteen Q1 operators; all prices and commission rates are as stated by the named practitioners, not independently verified.
